key_features: True Hardware Connection Freedom: Seamlessly adapts professional three-pin Cannon XLR male ports to standard 6.5mm female lines without signal bleeding.
Adjustable Aperture and Lock Switch: Advanced 6.0mm to 7.0mm cable sleeve tailoring with a mechanical latch provides a snug, vibration-resistant fit.
Premium Shielded Composition: Heavy-duty zinc alloy, ABS, and PVC composite shell delivers rugged physical defense against accidental drops.
Pure Uncompressed Audio Flow: Specialized internal layout prevents signal lag, hiss, and ambient ground noise during live performance tracking.
